resources.string: Only plans, study sessions, food ideas and reviews are eligible. Private Safety notes are excluded. Existing records and reflections are kept. Reimporting identical records preserves edits and deletions. OG exports no source IDs: changed source records are new imports. Time slots remain unscheduled. Session durations are reported summaries with calendar anchors, not measured intervals, and are excluded from measured-time graphs. Food benefits, diet and generated review text are unverified legacy claims. Habits, workouts and alarms are not invented or activated.
Legacy dates use calendar days in %1$s, without today’s logical-day boundary.
Records added: %1$d. Kept or previously imported: %2$d.
This OG file is unreadable, malformed, unsupported or exceeds the 5 MB / 5,000-record limit. Existing records were kept.
Import was not saved. Existing records and the preview were kept. You can retry.
OG reported duration (seconds): %1$d. Calendar date only; excluded from measured-time graphs.
OG reported study duration in this range (minutes): %1$d. Separate from measured-time totals.
This legacy duration has no measured intervals. Saving a correction creates an owner-entered interval at its calendar anchor and includes it in duration graphs.
OG recipe: diet and benefit claims are unverified. Review ingredients before use.
